notes: Standard VAT 20% (Ministry of Finance, VAT Act art. 66); investment gold exempt (VAT Act art. 160). Tavex BG, 27 Nov 2026: 1 g house bar sell 123 EUR, buy 111 EUR = 9.8% buyback discount. Prices dual-displayed EUR/BGN before euro adoption (1 Jan 2026). No primary-page spot read, so premiums empty; duty, making, used-gold null.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance (minfin.bg) - VAT rates
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the standard rate of 20% (VAT Act art. 66) applies to taxable supplies, imports and intra-EU acquisitions unless zero/reduced-rated
sources.quote: Стандартна ставка- 20 % (по чл. 66 от ЗДДС) се прилага за облагаеми доставки в страната, внос на стоки и вътреобщностни придобивания

sources.name: Ministry of Finance (minfin.bg) - Value Added Tax Act, art. 160
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 160(1) - supplies concerning investment gold shall be exempt
sources.quote: Article 160. (1) Supplies concerning investment gold shall be exempt where, for the purposes of this Act, the said supplies are: 1. supplies of investment gold

sources.name: Tavex Bulgaria - 1 g Tavex Gold Bar
sources.what: Dealer's own prices read 27 Nov 2026: We sell 123.00 EUR / We buy 111.00 EUR, stated spread 9.76% - bar buyback discount typical 9.8%. Prices dual-displayed in EUR and BGN.
